args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses
- Beach hat or cap
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Lightweight hiking clothes
- Rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Day backpack
- Insect repellent

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light sweater or jacket for cooler evenings
- Dressier outfit for the luau
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments and socks
- Workout clothes

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- SD cards for camera

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable water bottle
- Small daypack for excursions
